name: Whiskey
siboNotes: Alcohol can slow gut motility and may trigger symptoms in some SIBO patients, though whiskey itself contains no FODMAPs.
preparationTips: Choose plain whiskey without added flavors or mixers
Avoid whiskey-based cocktails with high FODMAP ingredients
Drink in moderation as alcohol can irritate the digestive system
Consider having with low FODMAP snacks to minimize stomach irritation
nutritionalHighlights: Provides calories from alcohol (7 calories per gram)
Contains trace amounts of antioxidants from aging process
